source.aggregation_formula: For each exact node ID, sum setup/call/teardown seconds per run, then take the median across all six runs.
source.profile_selection_formula: Keep node medians >= minimum_profiled_seconds only when the exact node ID has <= maximum_profiled_node_id_characters characters; round kept medians to duration_decimal_places.

consolidation.method: Sum the prior exact-node hints for each retained parameter input, using the existing fallback for unprofiled rows. These are derived estimates, not newly measured CI durations.
